{"initial_observation":{"company":"CLOSE_fin_05","message":"The ledger is accessed through the supplied SQL tools.","storage_note":"Pandas materializes recorded_at as SQLite YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS timestamps. Compare timestamps semantically, for example datetime(recorded_at)<=datetime(cutoff). Raw lexical comparison with a T-separated cutoff changes same-day ordering."},"max_actions":10,"task":"Company CLOSE_fin_05 keeps a single heterogeneous ledger table. Every record type is stored in ledger, so SQL self-joins and CTEs can be used. Close the payable ledger as it was known at recorded_at <= 2026-10-24T12:00:00, for business_date <= 2026-10-23. All timestamps are UTC ISO text. Start by excluding rows with future business dates and rows recorded late, then keep only the highest revision for each (kind,event_key). If that latest row has status void, the key is removed entirely; never fall back to an older row. Invoice rows use event_key as the invoice ID; payment, credit and hold rows use invoice_id to point to their parent invoice. Keep the active invoices for vendor BLUE with due_date <= 2026-10-30. Payments and credits reduce the gross amount_minor, in the invoice currency. Active holds reduce the remaining amount; holds with status release or void do not. Clamp as follows: remaining=max(0,gross-sum(payments)-sum(credits)), then unheld=max(0,remaining-sum(active holds)). For each invoice, pick the active terms row that has the same terms_code and the greatest business_date <= the invoice business_date (applying the same revision and as-of filtering). The discounted amount is unheld * (10000-discount_bps)/10000 only when 2026-10-23 <= discount_until; otherwise it is unheld. Next, pick the active FX row for that invoice's currency with the greatest business_date <= the invoice business_date. Convert to USD cents using fx_num/fx_den. Round only this final per-invoice amount to the nearest cent, rounding exact halves up. Sum the rounded per-invoice USD cents. Invoices in USD also have FX rows. Do not net invoices together before rounding. Submit only the integer number of USD cents.","task_id":"fin-05","tools":[{"description":"Get a list of available table names for a company.","name":"get_descriptions","parameters":{"additionalProperties":false,"properties":{"company_name":{"description":"The name of the company","type":"string"}},"required":["company_name"],"type":"object"}},{"description":"Get table metadata: description, columns, types, unique values.","name":"get_table_info","parameters":{"additionalProperties":false,"properties":{"company_name":{"description":"The name of the company","type":"string"},"table_name":{"description":"The name of the table","type":"string"}},"required":["company_name","table_name"],"type":"object"}},{"description":"Execute a SQL query on a table. arguments.query: SELECT kind,event_key,invoice_id,vendor,business_date,recorded_at,revision,status,amount_minor,currency,due_date,discount_until,terms_code,discount_bps,fx_num,fx_den FROM ledger WHERE date(business_date)<=date('2026-10-23') AND datetime(recorded_at)<=datetime('2026-10-24 12:00:00') ORDER BY kind,event_key,revision

trace.raw_text: {"tool":"sql_query","arguments":{"company_name":"CLOSE_fin_05","table_name":"ledger","query":"WITH filtered AS (SELECT * FROM ledger WHERE date(business_date)<=date('2026-10-23') AND datetime(recorded_at)<=datetime('2026-10-24 12:00:00')), ranked AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY kind,event_key ORDER BY revision DESC) AS rn FROM filtered), active AS (SELECT * FROM ranked WHERE rn=1 AND status<>'void'), inv AS (SELECT * FROM active WHERE kind='invoice' AND vendor='BLUE' AND date(due_date)<=date('2026-10-30')), adj AS (SELECT i.event_key, i.amount_minor AS gross, i.discount_until, i.business_date, i.currency, i.terms_code, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN a.kind='payment' THEN a.amount_minor ELSE 0 END),0) AS payments, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN a.kind='credit' THEN a.amount_minor ELSE 0 END),0) AS credits, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN a.kind='hold' AND a.status NOT IN ('release','void') THEN a.amount_minor ELSE 0 END),0) AS holds FROM inv i LEFT JOIN active a ON a.invoice_id=i.event_key AND a.kind IN ('payment','credit','hold') GROUP BY i.event_key), calc AS (SELECT a.*, MAX(0,gross-payments-credits) AS remaining, (SELECT t.discount_bps FROM active t WHERE t.kind='terms' AND t.terms_code=a.terms_code AND date(t.business_date)<=date(a.business_date) ORDER BY date(t.business_date) DESC LIMIT 1) AS discount_bps, (SELECT f.fx_num FROM active f WHERE f.kind='fx' AND f.currency=a.currency AND date(f.business_date)<=date(a.business_date) ORDER BY date(f.business_date) DESC LIMIT 1) AS fx_num, (SELECT f.fx_den FROM active f WHERE f.kind='fx' AND f.currency=a.currency AND date(f.business_date)<=date(a.business_date) ORDER BY date(f.business_date) DESC LIMIT 1) AS fx_den FROM adj a), amounts AS (SELECT event_key, MAX(0,remaining-holds) AS unheld, COALESCE(discount_bps,0) AS discount_bps, fx_num, fx_den, CASE WHEN date('2026-10-23')<=date(discount_until) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS discount_eligible FROM calc) SELECT SUM(CAST((2*(unheld*(CASE WHEN discount_eligible=1 THEN 10000-discount_bps ELSE 10000 END)*fx_num)+(10000*fx_den))/(2*(10000*fx_den)) AS INTEGER)) AS usd_cents FROM amounts"}}
